    About Orient Spa

    Welcome to Orient Spa Hanoi! We are a proud team of local receptionists and therapists who put the health and wellness of our visitors in the first place.

    Our spa treatments are tailored to meet different spa needs: foot massage, body massage, body holistic rituals and facial skin care. Visiting Orient Spa, you will not only find a place to give yourself a treat, but more importantly get a sense of friendly hospitable local Hanoians.

    We are open every day from 10 am to 10 pm. Contact us and start your wellness journey today!

    We are ready to serve you at locations of Hanoi's Old Quarter

    Visit Orient Spa Hanoi and take a heavenly break from your daily routine or pamper yourself nicely after a long trip.

    Orient Spa (Train Street Branch)

    Orient Spa - Train Street Branch is located at 36 Phung Hung Street, just a minute walk from the iconic Train Street. This venue offers Indochine charm with premier rejuvenation amidst the heart of ancient Hanoi Old Quarter.

    • No 36 Phung Hung, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Show on map
    • Open Daily: 10:00am - 10:00pm
    • Enquiry by phone or WhatsApp/Kakao: (+84) 916 903 499
    DISCOVER MORE

    Orient Spa (Cathedral Branch)

    Our Old Quarter branch is located in a boutique street named Au Trieu, on side of Saint Joseph Cathedral. From our spa, you can get a beautiful view of the cathedral, as well as a vivid observation of local life in the Old Town.

    • No 26 Au Trieu, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Show on map
    • Open Daily: 10:00am - 10:00pm
    • Enquiry by phone or WhatsApp/Kakao: (+84) 912 903 499
    DISCOVER MORE

    Orient & Flora - Spa and Nails

    Orient & Flora - Spa and Nails is a brand name under Orient Spa, with a focus on using flowers & plants as healthy treatment. Don't forget to book the floral bath treatment which is the signature of Orient & Flora - Spa and Nails.

    • No 22 Au Trieu, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Show on map
    • Open Daily: 10:00am - 10:00pm
    • Enquiry by phone or WhatsApp/Kakao: (+84) 867 903 499
    DISCOVER MORE

    Orient Spa (Old Quarter)

    Located in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter, our Hang Bong location embodies the essence of quiet luxury. Designed as a more intimate and curated retreat, this space offers a refined escape from the city’s bustle while remaining centrally connected.

    • No 113 Hang Bong, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi Show on map
    • Open Daily: 10:00am - 10:00pm
    • Enquiry by phone or WhatsApp/Kakao: (+84) 866 903 499
    DISCOVER MORE

    Our team

    Our staff is our most important resource we have at Orient Spa Hanoi. Great people form the basis of our company’s growth and prosperity. We are proud of our outstanding staff which comes from all parts of Vietnam.

    Ms. Thuy Spa Host

    Ms. Thuy is our Korean speaking receptionist at Orient Spa Hanoi. She is one of the founding members of Orient Spa back in our establishment in 2017.

    Ms. Linh (Kate) Spa Host

    Ms. Linh (Kate) has joined us since the very first phase of planning for Orient Spa. A dedicated and cheerful lady, Linh always welcomes Orient guests with her utmost enthusiasm and hospitality. Linh speaks well Vietnamese and English.

    Ms. Tinh Spa Therapist

    Ms. Tinh has 10 years specializing in Massage & Facial Care. Her attentive nature and calming presence create a healing experience where every customer can truly relax and feel cared for.

    Ms. Trang Spa Therapist

    A seasoned therapist with 11 years of experience, Ms. Trang is known for her confident techniques and thoughtful approach. Her skilled hands bring a sense of ease and trust to every treatment.

    Ms. Thanh Spa Therapist

    Known for her warm energy and wholehearted dedication, Ms Thanh makes each session feel personal, comfortable, and genuinely restorative. She has 10 years of spa experience.

    Ms. Ngoc Spa Therapist

    With 20 years of experience, Ms Ngoc is one of the most seasoned therapists at Orient Spa. Specializing in Foot & Body Massage, she brings exceptional expertise and practiced techniques to every treatment.

    Ms. Sao (Star) Spa Therapist

    Ms. Sao has had over 10 years in spa field and continually inspired us with her commitment for spa work. Her specialization is skin care and massage techniques.

    Mr. Thuong Spa Therapist

    After 15 years of experience across both Vietnamese and international spas, Mr. Thuong brings a refined understanding of massage techniques and professional care. His skilled approach helps every guest feel relaxed, balanced, and well cared for.

    Ms. Lan Spa Therapist

    With 10 years of experience, Ms. Lan brings a gentle touch and youthful energy to every Massage & Facial Care treatment, creating a warm and soothing experience for each guest.
